notes: Tarrant County uses countywide vote centers, so registered voters may vote at any listed location. Early voting runs 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. the first weekday week (Oct 19 to 23) and 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Oct 26 to 30, per the county schedule.
